bibl.title: Does Luke's Preface Resemble a Greek Decree? Comparing the Epigraphical and Papyrological Evidence of Greek Decrees with Ancient Preface Formulae.
bibl.seg: Zachary K. Dawson, Does Luke's Preface Resemble a Greek Decree? Comparing the Epigraphical and Papyrological Evidence of Greek Decrees with Ancient Preface Formulae.
bibl.note: Offers a critical evaluation of the argument by: John Moles, Luke's Preface: The Greek Decree, Classical Historiography and Christian Redefinitions, NTS 57 (2011) pp. 461-482. - 1. Introduction. - 2. Reading Luke's preface in light of scientific and historiographical preface writing. - 3. Reading Luke's preface in light of Greek decrees. - 4. Comparison of findings: 4.1. Matters of form; - 4.2. Matters of content. - 5. Conclusion.
